body.p: In response to the Office Action dated November 6, 2024, Applicant respectfully requests that the Examiner reconsider the above-captioned application in view of the following remarks.

Applicant thanks the Examiner for indicating that Claims 3-19 would be allowable if rewritten to include all of the limitations of the base claim and any intervening claims. To expedite prosecution, Applicant has filed herewith a Terminal Disclaimer as remarked below. Accordingly, Applicant requests prompt allowance of all the pending claims.
Rejection of Claim 2 Under Obviousness-Type Double Patenting

In the Office Action, Claim 2 was rejected under the judicially-created doctrine of obviousness-type double patenting as being unpatentable over Claim 1 of U.S. Patent No. 10,327,713. Although Applicant does not concede that the double patenting rejection is correct, to expedite allowance of this application, Applicant is filing herewith a Terminal Disclaimer in accordance with the requirements of 37 C.F.R. § 1.321. The filing of a terminal disclaimer to obviate a rejection based on nonstatutory double patenting and is not an admission of the propriety of the rejection. See M.P.E.P. § 804.02(II). Accordingly, Applicant respectfully requests entry of the Terminal Disclaimer and withdrawal of the double patenting rejection.

No Disclaimers or Disavowals

Although the present communication may include alterations to the application or claims, Applicant is not conceding that previously pending claims are not patentable over the cited references. Rather, any alterations are being made to facilitate expeditious prosecution of this application. Applicant reserves the right to pursue at a later date any previously pending or other broader or narrower claims that capture any subject matter supported by the present disclosure, including subject matter found to be specifically disclaimed herein or by any prior prosecution. Accordingly, reviewers of this or any parent, child, or related prosecution history shall not reasonably infer that Applicant has made any disclaimers or disavowals of any subject matter supported by the present application.

Any remarks in support of patentability of one claim should not be imputed to any other claim, even if similar terminology is used. Any remarks referring to only a portion of a claim should not be understood to base patentability on that portion or that the limitation discussed is essential or critical; rather, patentability must rest on each claim taken as a whole and not on any particular feature or combination of features. Furthermore, Applicant may not have presented in all cases, arguments concerning whether the applied references render the claims anticipated or obvious, and Applicant reserves the right to later submit additional or alternative arguments of patentability.

Aside from the present application, through standard continuation practice, Applicant has filed or may file additional applications that may have the same or similar supporting disclosure. Applicant requests Examiner review of the disclosure, claims, and prosecution history of such additional applications for any relevance to the present application, including review of, for example, any double patenting issues, pursuant to, inter alia, examination procedures in MPEP § 804. Please contact the undersigned to discuss any such issue.
